text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each panel shows 3 simulated days; the label describes the first day, and dashed lines mark midnights. Ranges drawn from: 1 to 4 units of 10 to 50 points (total at most 120); evening runs start 15 to 17.5 h for 2 to 6 h; morning runs start 5.5 to 8.5 h for 1 to 8 h; midday runs start 10 to 14 h for 1 to 4 h; ramps 0 to 4 half-hours; weekend factor 0.1 to 0.8.'
text.tspan: Each panel shows 3 simulated days; the label describes the first day, and dashed lines mark
midnights. Ranges drawn from: 1 to 4 units of 10 to 50 points (total at most 120); evening runs
start 15 to 17.5 h for 2 to 6 h; morning runs start 5.5 to 8.5 h for 1 to 8 h; midday runs
start 10 to 14 h for 1 to 4 h; ramps 0 to 4 half-hours; weekend factor 0.1 to 0.8.
